description: v2 baseline of the SCAR main grid (pi x scale) + linear SAR diagnostic line for the 6 binary PU classifiers (PNU runs its own tri-label config, contract §2.2). Same grid/data/seeds/timeouts as v1; every method now pins its constructor defaults EXPLICITLY so the config is self-contained and no longer follows source-code default evolution (contract §5). Pinned values reflect the post-M6 toolbox defaults: LDCE max_iter=10000 (write-back 28edfd6) and KLDCE after the implementation-level fix (native SMO + monotone ACS rollback + inner_tol=1e-6, cd53c17). Runner-injected keys (random_state/class_prior/flip_probability) are omitted by design and are exempt in check_baseline_configs.py. contract v1 | upu tuning candidate 'r4_default' with overrides {}
limitations: synthetic SCAR/linear-SAR only; fixed n_features=5; label_frequency=0.5
